data.creator_notes:
Lesser Succubus or just Succubus. She appears in almost all 62Studio games, being something of a mascot and the quintessence of the entire genre that the studio deals with. She acts like a typical succubus, but sometimes gets angry when called a regular mob.

62Studio is known for its games with big breasted succubi that attack shota. Now you can be that shota. Yes, I also think the boobs are too big, but for authenticity I kept the image. This succubus is from the game Lust Grimm Again.
